title: QuIP: 2-Bit Quantization of Large Language Models With Guarantees
one_line_relevance: Introduces incoherence processing plus LDLQ, proves the GPTQ/OPTQ relationship, and directly ablates rotation and feedback at low bitwidth.

title: QuIP#: Even Better LLM Quantization with Hadamard Incoherence and Lattice Codebooks
one_line_relevance: Combines randomized Hadamard incoherence, BlockLDLQ, and a fixed E8P lattice codebook with codebook and throughput ablations.

title: QuIP# reference implementation
one_line_relevance: Documents the custom CUDA, fast-Hadamard, model-conversion, and inference requirements behind QuIP# results.

title: QTIP: Quantization with Trellises and Incoherence Processing
one_line_relevance: Extends the QuIP lineage to high-effective-dimensional trellis codes under RHT and BlockLDLQ.

title: QTIP reference implementation
one_line_relevance: Shows the custom CUDA trellis decoder, transform dependencies, and tensor-parallel implementation.

title: AQLM: Extreme Compression of Large Language Models via Additive Quantization
one_line_relevance: Primary learned additive-codebook baseline at 2–3 bits without rotation or GPTQ-style sequential compensation.

title: AQLM reference implementation
one_line_relevance: Documents learned-codebook optimization, CUDA inference, vLLM integration, and published Mixtral checkpoints.

title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
one_line_relevance: Canonical practical sequential inverse-Hessian error-compensation method for LLM weights.

title: GPTVQ: The Blessing of Dimensionality for LLM Quantization
one_line_relevance: Directly composes learned vector centroids, Hessian-aware assignment, and GPTQ-style feedback.

title: AIMET GPTVQ API documentation
one_line_relevance: Evidence that GPTVQ is exposed as an implementable quantization workflow rather than only a paper algorithm.

title: VPTQ: Extreme Low-bit Vector Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
one_line_relevance: Provides the closest controlled learned-VQ ablation of second-order error propagation at 2.02 bpw.

title: VPTQ reference implementation
one_line_relevance: Documents the available CUDA/ROCm research implementation and serving roadmap.

title: QuaRot: Outlier-Free 4-Bit Inference in Rotated LLMs
one_line_relevance: Separates offline-fused and online rotations, measures Hadamard overhead, and ablates rotation with RTN/GPTQ.

title: QuaRot reference implementation
one_line_relevance: Shows the custom CUDA/fast-Hadamard requirements for the published activation-rotation path.

title: SpinQuant: LLM Quantization with Learned Rotations
one_line_relevance: Learns fused residual/value rotations, retains online Hadamards, and measures accuracy and runtime effects.

title: SpinQuant reference implementation
one_line_relevance: Documents which transforms are fused and the CUDA fast-Hadamard runtime dependency.

title: FlatQuant: Flatness Matters for LLM Quantization
one_line_relevance: Demonstrates learned online affine transforms and explicitly Triton-fused serving kernels.

title: FlatQuant reference implementation
one_line_relevance: Provides the Triton kernels and implementation details behind FlatQuant's online transformations.

title: Pyramid Vector Quantization for LLMs
one_line_relevance: Combines a fixed implicit vector code, Hadamard preprocessing, and GPTQ-style feedback, though without isolating their effects.

title: QAM-W: Joint 2D Codebook Quantization for LLM Weights via Hadamard Rotation and Activation-Aware Scaling
one_line_relevance: Uses deterministic Hadamard mixing with a universal small Lloyd code and identifies learned-codebook rotation comparisons as future work.

title: BTC-LLM: Efficient Sub-1-Bit LLM Quantization via Learnable Transformation and Binary Codebook
one_line_relevance: Directly ablates a learned codebook with and without a learned transform, albeit sub-1-bit and requiring online activation transforms.

title: AAAC: Activation-Aware Adaptive Codebooks for 4-bit LLM Weight Quantization
one_line_relevance: Recent learned codebook method using activation-aware weighting without rotation or sequential compensation.

title: llama.cpp quantize README
one_line_relevance: Documents current K/IQ quantization choices and the imatrix option in llama.cpp.

title: llama.cpp tensor encoding schemes
one_line_relevance: Describes the fixed GGUF tensor layouts used by K and IQ quantization families.

title: llama.cpp importance matrix derivation
one_line_relevance: Explains the diagonal activation-second-moment weighting used by the imatrix quantization path.

title: llama.cpp imatrix data comparison
one_line_relevance: Provides an operational but non-peer-reviewed perplexity comparison for K-quant with and without imatrix data.

title: LLM Compressor
one_line_relevance: Current implementation evidence for GPTQ, imatrix, rotation modifiers, and fixed low-precision formats in the vLLM ecosystem.

title: LLM Compressor imatrix example
one_line_relevance: Matched scalar 4-bit comparison of RTN, GPTQ, diagonal imatrix weighting, and their combination.

title: LLM Compressor SpinQuant modifier documentation
one_line_relevance: Documents the exposed rotation types and their fused versus online roles in LLM Compressor.

title: NVIDIA Model Optimizer
one_line_relevance: Implementation evidence for fixed FP/INT formats, GPTQ/local-Hessian algorithms, and deployment integrations.

title: NVIDIA Model Optimizer quantization recipes
one_line_relevance: Documents practical GPTQ, NVFP4/FP8, MoE, calibration, and deployment recipe coverage.

title: NVIDIA Model Optimizer quantization configuration
one_line_relevance: Documents the Hadamard rotation configuration exposed for QuaRot/SpinQuant-style quantization.
